name: thingtime-chatgpt
description: Secure multi-account Thingtime tools for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Use selected Thingtime accounts securely in ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription: Connect one or more Thingtime accounts with scoped, revocable tokens. Retrieve exact Things by ID, list comments for a known target, browse, search, create, update, comment, react, save, share, and switch accounts without exposing a token in chat.
defaultPrompt: Use my selected Thingtime account to help with my Things.
Retrieve a known Thing directly by ID, or search my Thingtime Things when I do not know the ID; ask for confirmation before any write.
